sentences.en: Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，许多地方传统已经衰落。

sentences.en: The express train is an hour faster than the local.
sentences.zh: 直达列车比普通列车快一个小时。

sentences.en: The way tourists dress offends the local standard of propriety.
sentences.zh: 游客的着装冒犯了当地的行为规范。
